# Judith Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 4 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:1** And the-sons of Israel, the-ones dwelling in Judea, heard all that Holofernes, the chief commander of Nebuchadnezzar king of-the Assyrians, had-done to-the nations, and how he-had-plundered all their temples and had-given them over to-destruction.

**4:2** And they-were-greatly-afraid before his face, and they-trembled for Jerusalem and for-the temple of-the Lord their God.

**4:3** For they-had-returned recently from-the captivity, and all-the people of Judea had just recently been-gathered-together, and the-vessels and the-altar and the-house [had been consecrated] after the-pollution.

**4:4** And they-sent into all-the territory of Samaria and Kona and Beth-horon and Belmain and Jericho and to Choba and Aesora and to-the valley of Salem,

**4:5** and they-seized-beforehand all-the heights of-the high mountains and they-fortified the-villages that-were in them and they-stored-up provisions for-the preparation of war, for their fields had-recently been-harvested.

**4:6** And Joakim the-high priest, who-was in Jerusalem in those days, wrote to-the ones dwelling in Bethulia and Betomesthaim which is opposite Esdraelon facing-toward the-plain near Dothan,

**4:7** commanding them to-seize-in-advance the-ascents of-the hill-country, because through them was the-entrance into Judea, and it-was easy to-prevent those-advancing, because the-approach was narrow, [allowing] only two men [to pass] together.

**4:8** And the-sons of Israel did as-had-been-commanded [to] them by Joakim the-high priest and the-council of-all-the people of Israel which was-sitting in Jerusalem.

**4:9** And every man of Israel cried-out to God with great earnestness and they-humbled their-souls with great earnestness.

**4:10** They and their-wives and their-children and their-cattle and every-sojourner and hired-servant and slave bought-with-their-money — they-girded sackcloth upon their-loins.

**4:11** And every man and woman and little-child and those-dwelling in Jerusalem fell-prostrate before the-temple and they-put ashes upon their-heads and they-spread-out their sackcloth before the-Lord.

**4:12** And the-altar also they-draped with sackcloth, and they-cried-out with one-accord with great earnestness to-the God of Israel not to-give their-infants into plunder and their wives into spoil and the-cities of their-inheritance into destruction and the-sanctuary into desecration and disgrace, as-a reproach to-the nations.

**4:13** And the-Lord heard their voice and looked-upon their affliction. The-people fasted many days in all-of Judea and Jerusalem before the-sanctuary of-the Lord Almighty.

**4:14** And Joakim the-high priest and all-the priests who-stood before-the-Lord and the-ones ministering to-the Lord, with sackcloth girded upon their-loins, were-offering the-continual-offering and the-vow-offerings and the-freewill-offerings of-the people.

**4:15** And [they had] ashes upon their-turbans, and they-cried-out to-the Lord with all their-might, so-that he-might look with-good-favor upon all-the house of Israel.
